A total of 137 candidates took this paper. The results were good, with 77% of candidates scoring 15 or
more. The median score was 19 and the mean marginally lower.
Candidates for the paper seemed well prepared which was reflected in the fact that a high proportion of
questions earning very high scores with candidates. The result of this was that very few questions caused
any difficulty and are discussed below.
